acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Appellant/husband seeks to adjust maintenance payments under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 with amounts awarded under Section 12 of the Domestic Violence Act, 2005.

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance awarded under Section 125 of the CrPC is adjustable against the amount awarded in matrimonial proceedings.
legal_principles.held: It is held that the maintenance awarded under Section 125 of the CrPC is adjustable against the amount awarded in matrimonial proceedings.
cited_cases: Sudeep Chaudhary Vs. Radha Chaudhary, (1997) 11 SCC 286

legal_principles.principle: Simultaneous proceedings for maintenance under different enactments are permissible, but the wife is under legal obligation to disclose the same in a subsequent proceeding.
legal_principles.held: The Apex Court has held that simultaneous proceeding for the maintenance is permissible, but this has also been directed by the Apex Court that if the wife is getting maintenance under previously instituted proceedings she is under legal obligation to disclose the same in a subsequent proceeding.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act — Section 20
cited_cases: Rajnesh Vs. Neha and others, (2021) 2 SCC 324

outcome.final_order: Amounts paid by appellant husband to be adjusted against maintenance payable under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
